parsed.rationale: All three members — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — are `type-alias-union` kinds in the same `Wallpaper` package with `shared_field_count: 16` and no differing slots (`differing_slots: null`), meaning their union bodies are structurally identical. No restraint markers are set on any record (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false). Maintaining three separate files for what is effectively the same 16-case blend-mode union creates a maintenance hazard: adding or removing a case must be done in three places. The `_Plant_` prefix on `_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift` suggests at least one of these may be a codegen or migration artefact that was never cleaned up.

specifics.proposed_action: Consolidate the three identical type-alias-union declarations — `PlaybackBlendMode` (PlaybackBlendMode.swift, line 21), `MaterialBlendMode` (MaterialBlendMode.swift, line 21), and `OverlayBlendMode` (_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift, line 21) — into a single canonical type (e.g., `BlendMode`) declared once in the `Wallpaper` package, then replace each of the three names with a `typealias` pointing to that canonical type, or delete the redundant aliases entirely if the call sites can be migrated to the single name.
specifics.why_no_category_fits: All three records are `type-alias-union` declarations, not structs, classes, or free functions, so `generic-parameterization`, `subclass-lift`, and `default-implementation` do not apply. They are not protocols, so `protocol-inheritance` and `pat-introduction` do not apply. They already live in the same package (`Wallpaper`), so `extract-to-common` (which requires moving to an upstream package) is not the right framing. The duplication is a straightforward case of three aliases with identical 16-field union bodies that should be collapsed to one canonical declaration inside the existing `Wallpaper` package, which is best described as an inline deduplication / rename rather than any of the named structural categories.
